scope: full article with every section, paragraph, quotation, list and table
granularity: main standalone claims; no node-count quota; examples and numbers as evidence
source: exact full-source SHA256 and reconstructed inventory
evidence: continuous source quotation; primary and all additional sections covered
supplements: independent qualifications and criticism retained with their own attribution and source, excluded from ranking input
review: independent full faithfulness and coverage; immutable target-bound proof; required findings zero
overrides: human decisions bound to the same reviewed target; no mechanical or review bypass
